process.title: From a local campaign to a warm investor on your desk

steps.d: We collect and organise your full investment documentation, then turn it into the knowledge base behind an AI chat. Investors get reliable answers in their own language, grounded solely in the developer's material.
We segment by what people actually do, not what they say.
Our moderator hosts the discussion. You present and answer questions live.
You receive an investor with a full intent profile and take the process from there, on your own or with our help.
We share contacts to verified law firms in the target market. That kind of backing earns investor trust.
Investors come back to future webinars for their next purchase, and they bring their friends.

You get demand, data, and direct contact with your clients. What you avoid is another salesperson standing between you and the buyer, juggling a portfolio of listings without deep knowledge of any of them.

tech.title: The webinar as a source of data, not an address list
tech.sub: At the heart of Vesteri sits our own webinar and AI platform, built around three things nobody else offers. Every campaign teaches the system a little more about what leads to a purchase.

cards.d: It answers investor questions on the spot, in their language. It knows every project in the portfolio in depth, works during the webinar, and keeps working long after. You never explain the same thing for the twentieth time, and you never worry that an agent forgot a detail or simply did not know it.
The platform records which project holds a participant's attention, what they ask, what they skip, and when they leave. A single meeting produces a profile of real interest.
The system rates how ready each participant is to buy and passes on only those who clear the qualification bar, together with a full record of their questions and interests.

buyers.main07: Listings are published by agents approved to join Collective. Every member commits to following our shared standards.

buyers.faq02: Clear answers about listings, agents and buying property.
buyers.faq04: Vesteri Collective is a selective network of vetted, independent real estate professionals. Its public marketplace brings together local and international property listings published by network members. You can freely browse properties, sign up for LIVE viewings and webinars, and use AI tools to learn as much as possible about a property without leaving home.
buyers.faq05: How is Vesteri Marketplace different from other property portals?
buyers.faq06: Traditional property portals mainly collect listings from agents and agencies working independently. Vesteri Marketplace is a shared sales space for a network of vetted professionals who commit to fair conduct, transparency and cooperation on agreed terms. This means your agent can help you find the right property beyond their own listings. Rather than competing only to win buyer enquiries, members are expected to work together with buyers’ needs in mind.
buyers.faq07: Can I search for local property as well as property abroad?
buyers.faq08: Yes. Vesteri is intended for local and international property searches, subject to listings actually available in each market. Explore the marketplace or contact a participating agent for guidance.
buyers.faq09: Will one agent help me find properties across the network?
buyers.faq10: Yes, if an agent agrees to guide your search. They can learn what you need, review listings from other Collective members and contact agents with suitable properties. The agents may also arrange a joint LIVE viewing or webinar and help guide you through the buying process. Communication, presentations and collaboration can take place within the Vesteri system. The scope of support depends on what you agree with your agent.
buyers.faq11: Can I buy directly through Vesteri or a Collective member?
buyers.faq12: Property transactions are handled through the relevant listing professional and other transaction parties. Vesteri Marketplace facilitates discovery and contact, and Vesteri may also directly represent selected international developments. Transaction arrangements vary by property and country.
buyers.faq13: Are all properties legally verified by Vesteri?
buyers.faq14: No. We review Collective members, their professional activities and their commitment to shared standards. This does not mean that every property has automatically undergone legal or technical due diligence. Selected overseas properties offered directly by Vesteri may undergo a different review process, but buyers should still confirm exactly what has been checked. We plan to expand buyer support, such as helping find an independent lawyer for property due diligence or providing guidance through a purchase. These services are not yet guaranteed for every transaction. Before buying, always consider independent legal and technical checks of the property.
buyers.faq15: How do I buy property abroad safely?
buyers.faq16: Check ownership, legal documentation, applicable taxes, financing rules, the developer’s background and the total cost of purchase. Use qualified, independent legal advisers in the relevant jurisdiction. Vesteri Marketplace does not replace legal due diligence, but we can support your process, including helping you find independent legal advisers and connecting you with people in our network who can assist. The assistance available depends on the property and destination.
buyers.faq17: Can I join a LIVE property viewing?
buyers.faq18: Where an agent schedules an Vesteri LIVE property presentation, buyers may view the property and ask questions remotely. LIVE availability depends on each listing and agent.

sellers.top05: Entrust your property sale to one agent who works with other Vesteri Collective members and has modern tools to showcase your property. You have one point of contact and can see how your agent is working to sell it.
sellers.how-it-works02: An exclusive agreement need not mean working alone.
sellers.how-it-works03: In a traditional arrangement, you appoint one agency and rely on its ability to find a buyer. In Collective, one agent manages your sale while working with other members of the network. That is the real strength of Collective!
sellers.how-it-works05: One agent leads the sale. Others can bring the buyer.
sellers.how-it-works06: Working together is a core principle of Vesteri Collective.
sellers.benefits02: Less to coordinate. More ways to sell.
sellers.benefits05: Know who handles viewings, buyer questions and the next steps. You do not have to manage conversations with multiple agencies.
sellers.benefits08: Other Collective agents with interested clients can also introduce your property. Your potential reach is not limited to one agent’s contacts.
sellers.benefits11: Members work within agreed referral and commission-sharing rules. The terms for your sale should be clear from the start.
sellers.choose02: Choose your agent or ask Vesteri to help.
sellers.choose03: You can appoint a Collective member you already trust. If you do not have someone in mind, contact Vesteri. We can discuss your needs and help you find a suitable way to choose an agent.
sellers.choose06: Pick a Collective member or ask for help finding one.
sellers.choose09: Discuss the price, fee, exclusivity, promotion plan and collaboration.
sellers.choose12: Your agent manages the process while other members may introduce buyers.
sellers.promotion02: Publishing a listing is only the beginning.
sellers.promotion03: Selling well means presenting the property, answering questions and reaching the right people. The Vesteri system gives agents tools to support that work.
sellers.promotion06: Buyers can see a property live and ask questions without travelling to it.
sellers.promotion09: Questions, answers and property materials can help future buyers understand the listing in greater depth.
sellers.promotion12: Your agent can use additional advertising tools if they are part of your agreed sales plan.
sellers.terms02: Agree on the sales plan before the terms.
sellers.terms03: An exclusive agreement can give one agent clear responsibility while still allowing collaboration across Collective. The commission rate alone does not determine the quality of service or the advertising budget. Ask what is included in the fee, who pays for additional promotion, when and how often the agent plans to hold LIVE property viewings, and how frequently you will receive progress reports.
sellers.terms04: One agent accountable for communication and managing the sale
sellers.terms05: Agreed rules for sharing the listing across the network
sellers.terms06: Transparent fees and a clear promotional plan
sellers.faq02: Straight answers about agents, exclusivity, fees and collaboration.
sellers.faq03: Do I have to sign an exclusive agreement?
sellers.faq04: There is no single mandatory arrangement for every property. You agree the type, length and scope of your contract with your chosen agent. If you opt for exclusivity, check that the agreement allows collaboration with other Collective members.
sellers.faq05: Will every Collective agent sell my property?
sellers.faq06: Your listing can be made available to other eligible members, subject to your agreement with your agent and the applicable collaboration rules. That does not mean every agent will actively promote it, and a sale is not guaranteed.
sellers.faq07: Who will contact me and conduct viewings?
sellers.faq08: Your appointed agent remains your primary point of contact. If another member helps with the sale, the roles and viewing arrangements should be agreed in advance.
sellers.faq09: Can I choose my own agent?
sellers.faq10: Yes. Choose a Collective member yourself, or contact Vesteri to discuss how to find the right person to manage your sale.
sellers.faq11: How much does selling through Collective cost?
sellers.faq12: Fees, services and any additional advertising budget are agreed before you sign a contract. There is no single published fee for every property. Ask your agent for a clear proposal and sales plan.
sellers.faq13: What if my agent does not follow the agreed plan?
sellers.faq14: Before listing, agree on activities, progress updates and how the relationship may end. Collective members commit to network standards, but your contractual rights and obligations follow your agreement with the agent.
sellers.faq15: Does Vesteri check the legal status of each property?
sellers.faq16: Approving professional members does not automatically mean verifying the legal or technical condition of every property. Agree which documents and independent checks are needed for your transaction.
sellers.main02: Your property. One agent. More possibilities.
sellers.main03: Tell us what you want to sell. We can discuss agent selection and how Collective could support the sale.
sellers.footer03: Vesteri Collective brings sellers, buyers and independent agents together through one collaborative network.

agents.main05: Accurate listings, respect for clients and keeping agreements are essential to working in Vesteri Collective.
agents.main07: Listings identify the professional representing each property, so buyers know who they are contacting.
agents.main09: Every listing in Vesteri Marketplace follows the same principles: accurate information, clear representation and respect for buyers, regardless of which Collective member offers it.
agents.main11: Client referrals and joint sales must follow clear rules, with defined responsibilities and respect for existing client relationships. Collective members are expected to cooperate with fellow members who have an interested buyer. Declining a collaboration request requires a credible, justified reason. Working together to serve clients is one of the network’s core principles.
agents.main13: Members commit to honest listings, transparent introductions, respecting buyer relationships and honouring documented cooperation terms. Material or repeated breaches can result in suspension or removal after a documented and fair review.
agents.main14: Fair play and trust are non-negotiable.
agents.main15: Honesty, respect for buyers and fellow agents, accurate listings and keeping agreed commitments are fundamental principles of Vesteri Collective. Material or repeated breaches can lead to suspension or termination of membership following a fair review process. These standards are binding on every Collective member.
agents.faq02: Membership, costs, commissions and working with other agents, explained clearly.
agents.faq04: Because working together can help you achieve more. Collective gives you clear ways to collaborate with other agents, offer clients a wider choice of properties and reach buyers beyond your current contacts. The Vesteri system helps save time, keep conversations in one place and answer client questions with AI tools, LIVE viewings and property promotion. It also strengthens your pitch to sellers: even when an owner appoints one agent exclusively, other Collective members may introduce interested buyers under agreed collaboration rules. One dedicated agent does not have to mean the reach of just one agency.
agents.faq05: Who can apply to Vesteri Collective?
agents.faq06: Independent real estate professionals and agencies may apply. Vesteri reviews identity, professional activity, applicable registrations or licences and acceptance of its Fair Play & Trust principles. Membership is selective and applications are not automatically approved.
agents.faq07: Can I publish property listings before approval?
agents.faq08: No. Under the selective-membership model, the public can browse the marketplace, but publication and Collective collaboration are reserved for approved professional members. Application and verification precede access to these functions.
agents.faq09: Does it cost anything to apply or publish listings?
agents.faq10: Applying to Collective and publishing standard listings are free for approved members. Core Vesteri system features are free as well. You can pay for additional tools as you use them or choose a subscription. Current limits, fees and premium features are shown in your Vesteri agent account.
agents.faq11: Do I keep my brand, clients and commission?
agents.faq12: Yes. Vesteri Collective is built for independent professionals. You keep your brand and your direct client relationships. Your commission on a sale of your own listing remains yours unless you separately agree to share it under clear referral or co-brokerage terms.
agents.faq13: Can I offer international properties outside my own portfolio?
agents.faq14: Yes. Collective helps you serve buyers beyond your own portfolio. Vesteri makes selected international developments available to members, and the network is committed to cooperation and commission sharing under agreed rules. For properties in Vesteri’s portfolio, we help arrange LIVE tours, webinars and conversations with developer representatives. We also support the subsequent cross-border purchase process. The agent who brings the buyer receives the larger share of the commission. Exact terms depend on the listing and applicable law.
agents.faq15: How do referrals and shared commissions work?
agents.faq16: Being open to collaboration is a core Collective principle. By joining, members accept the standard rules for referrals, buyer introductions and joint brokerage, including the baseline split of responsibilities and commissions. Exceptions should be rare and require agreement from both parties. Network-wide automated deal attribution and commission settlement are still being developed and are not yet available.
agents.faq17: How does Vesteri help with marketing and lead generation?
agents.faq18: The Vesteri system provides LIVE property presentations, AI tools and advertising automation to help promote listings and engage buyers. Results depend on factors such as budget, targeting, demand and execution. Vesteri also commits at least 10% of its revenue to promoting Vesteri Collective as a whole. This does not guarantee any individual agent a specific amount of traffic, enquiries or sales.
agents.faq20: Not yet. Private discussions, local peer groups and structured buyer requests are part of the longer-term product roadmap, not current membership features. Today the focus is on property listings, clear cooperation terms and Vesteri sales tools.
agents.faq21: What are the Fair Play & Trust principles?
agents.faq22: Approved members are expected to provide accurate listings, respect buyer privacy and existing client relationships, follow agreed cooperation terms and act honestly toward fellow members. Serious or repeated breaches may lead to suspension or removal through a documented review and appeals process.
agents.faq23: Do I need an exclusive agreement with Vesteri?
agents.faq24: No. Collective is designed for independent professionals, not as a conventional franchise. Joining does not itself require exclusivity. Any specific listing rights or other contractual obligations must be separately agreed and comply with local law.
agents.faq25: How does verification work and how long does it take?
agents.faq26: Vesteri intends to review identity, business activity, market-specific professional credentials and agreement to the Collective standards. The time required depends on the jurisdiction and completeness of the application. No approval timeline is guaranteed.
agents.faq27: These answers describe the proposed Collective model. Membership approval, permitted activity, fees, collaboration rights and procedures depend on the applicable published terms and local regulations.
